key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:3CFA
name: fill_words_and_count
description: Loops a fixed number of times, calling the random-value routine and storing one fixed word value at the target address on each pass. It also increments a global counter on every pass.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:3D12
name: place_spies_on_separate_cells
description: Repeatedly picks random positions, converts them to map coordinates and retries until the two spies are a set distance apart. The result is stored in the map and window position variables for both spies.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:3DEA
name: advance_random_state
description: Updates three random-generator state words with additions, a rotate-and-subtract step and an exclusive-or with a constant. Several routines call it to get the next random value.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:3E1E
name: call_advance_random_state
description: Calls the random-state advance routine and returns whatever value it leaves in the registers as a long word. It adds no logic of its own.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:3E28
name: pick_random_empty_table_entry
description: Advances the random state, derives a table offset from its bits and loops until the table entry at that offset is zero. It then returns the address of that entry.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:3E70
name: split_offset_into_grid_coordinates
description: Subtracts a base value from the input offset, halves it, and divides it by ninety-six. It stores the quotient and remainder in two output words, which convert a linear position into grid coordinates.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:3E8A
name: clear_clock_and_fuel_values
description: Sets the four clock digit values and both spies' fuel values to all ones, so they are marked as cleared. Its only caller is the main game routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4000
name: show_crash_register_dump
description: Crash handler: saves the stack area, copies the palette, clears the screen buffer and prints register and stack contents as text. It then loops forever, so the machine never returns from it.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:40FE
name: print_two_hex_quads
description: Runs the four-item print loop twice in a row, so one call prints an eight-item block. It is used by the crash handler to print register values.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4108
name: print_hex_and_text_group
description: Repeatedly prints a hexadecimal value and then a zero-terminated text string until the loop counter reaches zero. The crash handler uses it to print labelled register and stack values.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4132
name: print_hex_item_loop
description: Calls the single-character output routine repeatedly until the data register value reaches zero. The crash handler uses it to print hexadecimal digits.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:414E
name: print_zero_terminated_text
description: Walks a text pointer and sends each character to the single-character output routine until it reads a zero byte. It returns the data register value unchanged.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4178
name: emit_text_until_nul
description: Emits one character at a time from the pointer register until it reads a zero byte. It is a branch target of the text printing routine and shares its loop.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4180
name: print_text_until_zero_byte
description: Loops on the single-character output routine while the byte at the pointer is not zero. It is a second entry point for the same text loop used by the text printing routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:418A
name: stub_return_stack_word
description: Stub with no effect: it returns the stack word unchanged and does nothing else.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:418E
name: draw_glyph_into_four_planes
description: Copies the eight rows of one character from the font table into four bitplanes of screen memory. Character code thirty-six is skipped, and each row moves forward by one screen line.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:41D6
name: stub_return_stack_value
description: Stub with no effect: it returns the stack value unchanged and does nothing else.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:41E2
name: install_illegal_instruction_vectors
description: Stores the address of the illegal-instruction routine into one global location three times. The start-up code calls it to install that handler.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4256
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Holds only bad instruction data, so control flow would run into invalid bytes and halt. It is a data block, not a working routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4276
name: draw_visible_spy_sprites
description: Checks whether each spy's map cell matches the current window, then computes its screen offsets and plots its sprite into the screen buffer. It then draws the hands sprite for the matching spy.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:427A
name: draw_spy_sprites_by_window
description: Checks each spy's map cell against the current window and, on a match, computes screen offsets, plots the spy sprite and draws its hands. It is the same sprite routine as its neighbours, differing only in its return path.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4296
name: draw_matching_spy_sprites
description: Repeats the map-cell check and sprite plot for each spy in the window, drawing the spy and its hands when the cell matches. It has the same body as its neighbours and returns the hand result.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:42B6
name: draw_spy_sprites_from_stack
description: Performs the same per-spy map-cell check and sprite plot as its neighbours, returning through the stack path used by the crash handler. It draws the spy sprite and its hands on a match.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:43B6
name: draw_spy_sprites_user_stack
description: Performs the same per-spy map-cell check and sprite plot as its neighbours, returning through the user stack pointer path. It draws the spy sprite and its hands on a match.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:43BE
name: draw_spy_sprites_by_cell
description: Checks each spy's map cell against the window and, on a match, plots its sprite and hands into the screen buffer. It is called from the spy-drawing routine and returns nothing.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4820
name: draw_spy_hands_sprite
description: Draws the hands sprite for one spy when that spy is not carrying a special state and its depth and swamp values are small enough. It picks the hand frame from the spy's hand value and plots it at a computed offset.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4994
name: draw_seven_buttons
description: Calls the single-button drawing routine seven times in a row to draw the full button row.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4AC4
name: draw_button_full_or_empty
description: Draws one button using either the empty or the full glyph, depending on a flag passed in. It sets the sprite position and single-width buffer before plotting.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4B1C
name: redraw_changed_clock_digits
description: Compares each of the four clock digits with its stored value and redraws only the digits that changed. It is called from the movement drawing routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4B96
name: draw_horizontal_line_wrapper
description: Calls the horizontal line routine and returns the register values it leaves behind. It adds no logic of its own.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4BC4
name: redraw_energy_meters
description: Clamps each spy's energy value to the range zero to sixty-five and redraws its meter bar, skipping the full and empty extremes. It is called from the movement drawing routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4C80
name: flash_sprites_on_counter
description: Draws two sprites, then draws the flash sprites twice more only when bit two of the global counter is set. It is called from the movement drawing routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4CE4
name: draw_flashing_sprite_frames
description: Clears a sprite field, then draws the sprite frames selected by a three-bit state value, adding extra frames under certain flag conditions. It is called only by the flash routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4D6E
name: update_if_value_changed
description: Returns without change if the data value matches both the word at the pointer and the word after it. Otherwise it stores the value into the word at the pointer.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4D88
name: draw_spy_sprite_with_rocket
description: Chooses one spy's sprite to draw, splitting wide sprites into two plots when the spy is at its last hand frame. When the spy's rocket is active it clears the hand and advances the rocket's sprite data and length.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4EB6
name: draw_masked_sprite_to_planes
description: Draws a shifted sprite into four bitplanes by clearing the destination with an inverted mask and then merging the sprite words. It repeats across each sprite row.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4F7A
name: draw_sprite_rows_after_clear
description: Clears each destination row in four bitplanes, then ORs in the shifted sprite words for each column of the row. It repeats across the sprite's rows.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4FEA
name: copy_shifted_sprite_rows
description: Continues the shifted sprite copy row by row across the buffer. It clears the next column's destination words and ORs in the shifted source words.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:4FFC
name: save_screen_rectangle_to_buffer
description: Copies a rectangle of four bitplane words from screen memory into a save buffer, row by row. Other routines call it before drawing over an area.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5034
name: restore_buffer_to_screen_rectangle
description: Copies a saved rectangle from the buffer back into four bitplanes of screen memory, row by row. It undoes an earlier save of the same area.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:506C
name: pack_planes_or_into_buffer
description: Stores a width-and-height header, then writes each row of the buffer as the OR of the four bitplane words from screen memory. It is the save-to-buffer variant used when grabbing a region.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:50D6
name: copy_planes_with_size_header
description: Writes a width-and-height header, then copies the four bitplane words of each screen row into the buffer. Its grab routine calls it, and it is a variant of the OR-packing routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:512A
name: blit_sprite_with_minterms
description: Programs the hardware blitter registers with the source, mask, destination pointers, modulo values and minterm logic, then starts the blit and waits for it to finish. Sprite drawing calls it for masked sprite plots.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5228
name: draw_sprite_via_rsprite
description: Calls the masked sprite routine and returns its register values. It adds no logic of its own and is called by sprite drawing and button drawing.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:525A
name: blit_sprite_wrapper
description: Calls the blitter-based sprite routine and returns its register values. It adds no logic of its own.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5286
name: draw_background_wrapper
description: Calls the background sprite routine and returns its register values. It adds no logic of its own.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:52B8
name: run_snow_weather_update
description: Advances the snow timing, chooses the sleet or snow graphic from the minute counters, and draws snow flakes for each spy not inside an igloo. Several entry points share this same body.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:52BC
name: run_snow_weather_update_width
description: Runs the same snow weather update as its neighbours, with the same timing, graphic choice and per-spy flake drawing. It is one of several entry points to that body.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:52C0
name: run_snow_weather_update_buffer
description: Runs the same snow weather update as its neighbours, with the same timing, graphic choice and per-spy flake drawing. It is one of several entry points to that body.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:52C4
name: run_snow_weather_update_screen
description: Runs the same snow weather update as its neighbours, with the same timing, graphic choice and per-spy flake drawing. It is one of several entry points to that body.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:52C8
name: run_snow_weather_update_minterms
description: Runs the same snow weather update as its neighbours, with the same timing, graphic choice and per-spy flake drawing. It is called from the blitter sprite routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:52CA
name: update_snow_and_draw_flakes
description: Advances the snow timing and draws snow flakes for each spy not inside an igloo. It is called from the movement drawing routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:538E
name: draw_snow_flakes_to_planes
description: Draws the snow flake graphic into the screen planes for each spy's column, using a per-row pattern table and a counter. It is called from the snow update routines.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5410
name: draw_next_char_wrapper
description: Calls the font-glyph routine for the current character and returns with no other work. It is called by the snow flake and snow update routines.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5434
name: draw_font_nibble_glyph
description: Copies one eight-row character from the font table into four bitplanes, choosing the character from the low four bits of the data value. Each row moves forward by one screen line.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:55C6
name: stub_return_nothing
description: Stub with no effect: it returns immediately without changing any state.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:55F2
name: plot_point_in_four_planes
description: Sets or clears one pixel by applying a mask to the four bitplane words at the current screen address. Line drawing calls it for each point.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5610
name: check_horizontal_step_flag
description: Reads the left-movement flag and a bit of the data value, then returns without changing any state. Line drawing calls it when stepping across.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:563E
name: check_vertical_step_flag
description: Reads the left-movement flag, then returns without changing any state. Line drawing calls it when stepping up or down.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5654
name: draw_line_between_points
description: Computes the horizontal and vertical step directions and a slope value, then plots points along the line by stepping one axis at a time. It is called from the line and selection drawing routines.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5724
name: fill_left_line_segment
description: Walks a vertical span of rows, clearing or setting pattern bits in the four bitplanes and jumping to edge handlers at the span's ends. It is the leftward variant used by line drawing.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5728
name: draw_horizontal_pattern_line
description: Draws a horizontal line of pattern bits across the bitplanes, clearing or setting bits by pattern value and handling the run's edges. Its wrapper calls it for horizontal lines.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5762
name: fill_row_bits_plane_one
description: Clears or sets pattern bits in the first three bitplanes as it walks a row, stopping when the row count runs out. It is one of a set of routines that each start at a different bitplane.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5776
name: fill_row_bits_plane_two
description: Clears or sets pattern bits starting from the second bitplane as it walks a row, stopping when the row count runs out. It is one of a set of routines that each start at a different bitplane.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:578C
name: fill_row_bits_plane_three
description: Clears or sets pattern bits starting from the third bitplane as it walks a row, stopping when the row count runs out. It is one of a set of routines that each start at a different bitplane.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:57A2
name: fill_row_bits_then_line
description: Clears pattern bits in the fourth bitplane for each row, then continues into the horizontal line routine. It is the last of the bitplane-by-bitplane row fill routines.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:57B2
name: fill_whole_words_from_pattern
description: Writes whole sixteen-pixel words into all four bitplanes from the low pattern bits, stepping sixteen pixels at a time while enough remain. It is called at the end of a horizontal line.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:57CE
name: write_pattern_words_plane_one
description: Writes sixteen-pixel pattern words into the first bitplane, setting or clearing each word from the pattern bits. Other bitplanes are written by the sibling routines.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:57DE
name: write_pattern_words_plane_two
description: Writes sixteen-pixel pattern words into the second bitplane, setting or clearing each word from the pattern bits. It is one of the sibling routines for the other bitplanes.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:57F0
name: write_pattern_words_plane_three
description: Writes sixteen-pixel pattern words into the third bitplane, setting or clearing each word from the pattern bits. It is one of the sibling routines for the other bitplanes.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5802
name: write_pattern_words_plane_four
description: Writes sixteen-pixel pattern words into the fourth bitplane, setting or clearing each word from the pattern bits. It is one of the sibling routines for the other bitplanes.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5810
name: write_partial_pattern_word
description: Writes the leftover pattern bits of a line that do not fill a whole sixteen-pixel word, setting or clearing one bit at a time across the bitplanes.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5828
name: rotate_pattern_bits_plane_one
description: Rotates the pattern value one bit at a time and clears or sets bits in the first bitplane for each step. It is one of a set of routines that each cover a different bitplane.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:583C
name: rotate_pattern_bits_plane_two
description: Rotates the pattern value one bit at a time and clears or sets bits in the second bitplane for each step. It is one of a set of routines that each cover a different bitplane.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5852
name: rotate_pattern_bits_plane_three
description: Rotates the pattern value one bit at a time and clears or sets bits in the third bitplane for each step. It is one of a set of routines that each cover a different bitplane.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5868
name: rotate_pattern_bits_then_line
description: Rotates the pattern value and clears or sets bits in the fourth bitplane, then falls through to the horizontal line routine. It finishes the set of pattern rotation routines.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:587C
name: mask_point_value
description: Combines the two low data registers and masks the result down to a single bit pattern, returning it. Horizontal line drawing calls it to get the pixel mask.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:589E
name: update_random_seed_words
description: Updates the three random seed words with additions and a rotate by a shift count taken from the low bits, then subtracts the result from one seed. It supplies random values to the game.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:58E4
name: read_both_player_triggers
description: Reads the joystick scan and the keyboard for each player and sets that player's trigger word to all ones when fire is held, or to zero otherwise. It is called from the setup and parameter routines.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:59BA
name: update_player_movement
description: Dispatches each spy's movement by its control mode, choosing joystick, keyboard, computer logic or random movement, and then updates both positions. It is called from the main game routine.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5B72
name: set_spy_direction_four
description: Sets the spy direction value to four and writes two into the location the caller passes in. It is a short direction-setting branch.

key: spy vs spy - the island caper (1989)(wicked software)/Spy vs Spy - The Island Caper (1989)(Wicked Software).adf:d/spy3:0:5BA4
name: set_spy_direction_three
